Next, Biles is interviewed, with another woman standing near her. The clip cuts to a shot of bulldogs, and then to a clip with Biles and Owens together, smiling at each other. Text on the screen says, "We kind of had that time to ourselves to see if we like each other." Another interview clip shows Biles talking, followed by a photo of Biles and Owens standing close. An interview clip shows Owens stating, "We just kind of started hanging out more and more and you start to want to see a person," and the video ends with Biles standing in a building holding a gym bag and a woman holding up French bulldogs.
